title: Swords in tarot: court card meanings
description: The Page, Knight, Queen and King of Swords in tarot: upright and reversed meanings, and how court cards can be people, aspects of yourself or approaches.

scenes.headline: Swords in tarot: court card meanings
scenes.caption: The Swords court cards describe four ways of using the mind, from the curious Page to the fair-minded King. They can be people, parts of you or approaches.
scenes.vo: The Swords court cards describe four ways of using the mind, from the curious Page to the fair-minded King. They can be people, parts of you or approaches.

scenes.headline: Page of Swords
scenes.caption: Curiosity, new ideas, a keen eye. The Page stands alert, sword raised, in a windy landscape.
scenes.vo: Page of Swords. Curiosity, new ideas, a keen eye. The Page stands alert, sword raised, in a windy landscape.

scenes.headline: Knight of Swords
scenes.caption: Drive, speed, directness. The Knight is usually shown charging forward with sword held high. He stands for acting on an idea at once, with determination and little pause.
